headline: DeepSeek V4 Flash sparks an AI price war
body: DeepSeek released V4 Flash, a coding model close to Claude Opus 4.8 at roughly 99% lower cost, as US labs also cut prices. Cheap, strong models spread capability beyond a few companies, lowering Power Concentration. That helps Libertarian Utopia and Egalitarian Utopia and weighs on Enslaved God and Zookeeper. Google also pulled an AI image feature in Google Earth within a day after people used it to fake disaster, conflict and sensitive-site scenes at real locations. Acting quickly on misuse counts as a small plus for Alignment & Control, which nudges Protector God and Gatekeeper up and Conquerors down. Horizon Balance improved to -2.09.
movers_note: Libertarian Utopia +0.3 came from DeepSeek V4 Flash (+0.21) and Google's quick pullback (+0.07); Egalitarian Utopia +0.2 and Zookeeper -0.2 followed the same two events.
